title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East on 1970-11-16
source: SBD > RR > ? > ? > Cassette; Transfer Info: Nak MR2 Deck > Cassette > WAV >Soundforge > FLAC

ai_review.summary: Incomplete, out‑of‑order recording with an ominously beautiful 'Cold Rain and Snow' featuring Garcia’s wah‑wah.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers note that the tape is missing sections and is mis‑sequenced, making it hard to enjoy as a full concert document. Despite the technical shortcomings, the rendition of “Cold Rain and Snow” is praised for its moody atmosphere and Jerry Garcia’s expressive wah‑wah guitar work.

ai_rating.rationale: Low star ratings and comments about incompleteness dominate, though a positive note on one song prevents the rating from being at the absolute bottom.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers describe the file as incomplete and out of order; no information about soundboard vs. audience or clarity is provided.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set appears fragmented due to missing/ mis‑sequenced material, limiting overall flow.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Great wah‑wah playing on 'Cold Rain and Snow' noted by reviewers.
